# Feature: Schedule Management

## Overview
Implement a comprehensive staff scheduling system that handles work hours, time off, and schedule optimization.

## User Stories

1. Work Schedule
   - As a staff member
   - I want to set my regular work hours
   - So that I'm only booked during available times

2. Time Off Management
   - As a staff member
   - I want to request and manage time off
   - So that my availability is accurate

3. Schedule Optimization
   - As a manager
   - I want to optimize staff schedules
   - So that we maintain efficient coverage

4. Break Management
   - As a staff member
   - I want to configure break times
   - So that I have proper rest periods

5. Schedule Conflicts
   - As a scheduler
   - I want to detect and resolve schedule conflicts
   - So that we prevent double-booking

## Technical Tasks
- [ ] Create schedule builder interface
- [ ] Implement time off system
- [ ] Build optimization engine
- [ ] Create break scheduler
- [ ] Implement conflict detection
- [ ] Add schedule validation
- [ ] Create schedule templates
- [ ] Implement schedule sync
- [ ] Add scheduling analytics
- [ ] Create reporting system

## Acceptance Criteria
- Work hours set properly
- Time off manages correctly
- Optimization improves efficiency
- Breaks schedule appropriately
- Conflicts resolve automatically
- Validation prevents errors
- Templates work effectively
- Reports provide insights

## Technical Notes
- Use scheduling algorithms
- Implement proper validation
- Use background jobs for optimization
- Cache schedule data
- Follow SOLID principles
- Implement proper logging

## Estimate
- Story Points: 13
- Time Estimate: 1.5 weeks

## Dependencies
- Service Assignment feature
- Calendar Integration
